Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe is building the economic engine for AI – and it’s working. Today, 88% of the Forbes AI 50 are building on Stripe (and most of the remaining 12% are pre-monetization).
The AI GTM team is focused on helping AI-native businesses monetize and scale. We're in a unique position—partnering with the world's most ambitious AI companies (like OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and NVIDIA) to help them grow. This is one of the fastest growing parts of the business, and we need more great people to help us continue to accelerate.

As a Sales Manager on the AI GTM team at Stripe, you will leverage your sales leadership and product expertise to drive growth through new and existing strategic AI customers. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer of AI, you will lead a team of Account Executives responsible for expanding Stripe's relationship with some of the most important AI companies in the world—across payments, billing, and beyond.
You will be instrumental in leading in-depth product discussions with customers, developing consultative and solution-based sales strategies, and building deep knowledge of the AI industry and its unique monetization challenges. You will collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Product Marketing, and User Operations teams to develop and execute against our go-to-market strategy.

Develop the long-term vision for a growing AI GTM team and scale day-to-day operations.
Lead and manage a team of Account Executives managing existing AI accounts (driving revenue expansion, product attach, and retention) and looking for new business opportunities. Establish strategic plans and objectives to drive growth across the AI GTM business line, guiding execution to KPIs.
Build and develop a high-performing team, fostering a strong culture of energized and engaged Stripes while investing in the growth and development of your team. Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills throughout the sales cycle.
Be accountable for driving revenue, increasing product attach rates, and growing existing clients at high rates.
Engage with Product, Marketing, and User Operations teams to influence our product roadmap (you are on the frontier!) and accelerate our growth trajectory for our AI industry users.
Serve as both an internal and customer-facing expert on Stripe's products, particularly as they apply to AI-native business models (usage-based billing, marketplace payments, embedded finance, agentic commerce).
Build strong relationships with customer executives (CEO, CFO, CTO) and serve as a trusted advisor on how Stripe can support their growth.
Create best practices and improve the business and customer engagement model.

Sales leader. You are an adept sales leader, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization. You see value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require both deep product understanding and technical knowledge, especially for AI industry users.
People developer. You are a strong people leader who builds high-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and culture. You're as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives) and are excited to become an expert and share your knowledge. You possess an organized, self-starter mindset and excellent communication skills, with a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.
AI enthusiast. You have deep context in the AI industry and are energized by keeping up with new developments in the space. You bring a user-first mindset— you approach every customer interaction as a consultative partner rather than a transactional seller.
Technically curious. You understand APIs, webhooks, and modern developer tools—and you can hold credible conversations with engineering leaders about how Stripe's infrastructure fits into their stack.

8+ years of sales leadership experience, launching and growing high-functioning sales teams/products.
10+ years of experience in hyper-growth SaaS or technology environments across the AMER region.
Demonstrated success managing existing/growth customer portfolios and driving revenue expansion.
Proven ability to be a self-starter, capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders.
Deep understanding of AI industry dynamics, business models, and monetization strategies (usage-based pricing, API-first distribution, agentic commerce).
Strong product acumen—ability to learn and articulate complex product capabilities, understand how they work technically, and connect them to user needs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong presentation skills for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders.
An enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality.
Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke agreements with commercial and enterprise businesses.

Industry experience in payments, financial infrastructure, developer tools, or AI/ML platforms.
Existing relationships within the AI ecosystem (AI labs, AI-native SaaS companies, developer platforms).
Experience selling complex platform solutions involving multiple products.
Prior experience at a growth-stage software company or a leading payments/fintech company.
Familiarity with Stripe's product suite and how AI companies leverage financial infrastructure to scale.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
We're looking for a Client Account Manager to join the Media & Entertainment vertical of our Global Strategic Accounts team. This team is a specialized group within Global Large Customer Sales that oversees Reddit’s most significant global advertising partners end-to end — leading joint business planning, global strategy, and cross-regional execution.
This person will closely collaborate with their Client Partner on campaign execution and optimizations to help agencies and advertisers achieve their marketing objectives on the fast-growing Reddit platform.
Please note that this role is required to be based out of New York City or Los Angeles.

Collaborate closely with Client Partners to meet and exceed your clients’ marketing goals
Proactively manage and deepen relationships with existing advertising partners, both with agencies and directly with Global clients, to drive year-on-year Reddit revenue growth
Lead and execute campaign launches from start to finish, delivering insightful optimization recommendations to agency and client partners
​​Run end-to-end global account operations: revenue delivery, complex media strategy, multi-market optimizations, troubleshooting, and structured upsell on a global book
Act as the primary point of contact for internal account operations, including managing revenue delivery, troubleshooting issues, and escalating when necessary
Educate brands and media agencies, effectively communicating Reddit’s value proposition and best practices for advertising on the platform
Consult clients on their awareness and direct response objectives, partnering closely with Client Partners to craft thoughtful and creative media plans
Collaborate with Ad Ops to ensure effective campaign delivery and resolve any technical hurdles
Dive deep into campaign performance data, audience and competitor insights, seasonality, and market and performance trends to develop KPI-driven campaign recommendations
Proactively seek and represent client needs and asks to cross-functional stakeholders

Collaborate closely with Client Partners to meet and exceed clients’ marketing goals.
Proactively manage and deepen relationships with existing advertising partners, both with agencies and directly with Fortune 500 clients to drive year-on-year Reddit revenue growth.
Lead and execute campaign launches from start to finish and deliver insightful optimizations to agency and client partners
Ongoing management of internal account operations (revenue delivery and troubleshooting issues)
Educate brands and media agencies, effectively communicate value proposition and best practices
Consult clients on their awareness and direct response objectives, and partner closely with Client Partners to craft thoughtful and creative media plans
Collaborate with Ad Ops to ensure effective campaign delivery and resolve any technical hurdles
Proactively seek and represent client needs and asks to cross-functional stakeholders
Shape Reddit’s native ads product roadmap, for mobile and in general, by aggregating and sharing client feedback and campaign metrics with cross-functional stakeholders
Proactively and continually identify areas of improvement
Mentor and train other team members.

8+ years of experience in advertising sales and account management, Media & Entertainment client experience preferred
Strong understanding of customer marketing funnel and traditional marketing ecosystem
Comfortable with problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.

Tenacious and entrepreneurial approach to working through product, process, and client challenges

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.
We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

We are hiring a Client Success Account Manager to our Client Success team in Paraná.
This role is to join the B2B team and will be responsible for managing a key portfolio of our clients. As a Client Success Manager, you will be expected to bring significant business results to Wellhub through upselling, cross selling and renegotiation within existing accounts. This person will also work in collaboration with different areas of Wellhub to improve and evolve the client's experience.
This is a great opportunity to join a growing team in a market that is really gaining momentum on B2B business and we are excited to have a game-changer candidate to take us to the next level.

Develop a sales plan for each named client — identifying products, expansion opportunities, and the strategic rationale ("why Wellhub") — leading the client relationship for a portfolio of large and complex Enterprise accounts throughout the client lifecycle.
Ensure contract renewals, expansions, and lead annual contract renegotiations.
Partner with client's HR and decision makers, building an approach to connect their C-level to Wellhub executives (and/or executives at other clients) to broaden and deepen engagement with Wellhub.
Use data and market analysis to identify risks, opportunities, and build data-backed narratives to support negotiations and retention strategies.
Provide product feedback (client requirements, product shortcomings, enhancements, etc.) to product management.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Based in Paraná — hybrid model, with in-person client visits.
Previous experience in a client-facing role, leading large and complex Enterprise client relationships, with proven cross-selling and upselling results in an existing portfolio.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to support decision-making, negotiations, and client strategy.
Strong communication skills to engage with senior stakeholders, including Director and C-level audiences.
Ability to identify root causes and solve problems creatively and efficiently.
Ability to operate independently and manage multiple clients/projects concurrently with strong attention to detail.
Able to analyze and improve current processes/protocols and anticipate/manage change in a fast-moving global business environment.
Highly proficient in English.
We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience managing large and complex Enterprise client portfolios and advanced proficiency in English, are mandatory requirements.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.
Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.
HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.
Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube !
Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!
This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

About Zscaler
Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.
Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats.

We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.
We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.
The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to lead a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.
We're looking for an Account Executive, Majors based in Massachusetts metro to join our East team. Reporting to the Regional Director, you will:
Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers
Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals
Collaborate with our teams to meet customer needs and contribute to account planning
Be a trusted advisor, understanding client businesses and aligning Zscaler solutions with their goals

Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving"
10+ years of full-cycle sales experience within software or security industry
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Progressive selling experience engaging with accounts and selling at C-Level
Demonstrate curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

Role
We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Germany, reporting to the Sales Director in the Enterprise sales department. Take ownership of an assigned territory in Germany focused on net new logo and up-sell opportunities with Enterprise prospects and customers
Demonstrate expertise in building business cases that clearly show value and differentiation at all levels of your customer and prospect organizations

You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

## About Our Client ##
Das Unternehmen ist ein Schweizer Technologieanbieter mit Fokus auf die Baubranche und entwickelt moderne, cloudbasierte Softwarelösungen, die Prozesse rund um Projekte, Druck und Administration effizienter und transparenter machen.
## Job Description ##
* Identifikation, Ansprache und Gewinnung von Neukunden im Schweizer Bau- und Planungsumfeld
* Aufbau und Pflege eines relevanten Netzwerks aus Architekten, Ingenieuren, Planern, Generalunternehmen, Bauunternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern bzw. Kantonen
* Durchführung überzeugender Produktpräsentationen, Demos und Beratungsgespräche
* Begleitung potenzieller Kunden vom ersten Kontakt über die Bedarfsanalyse bis zum Vertragsabschluss
* Analyse individueller Kundenbedürfnisse und Erarbeitung passender Lösungsansätze
* Identifikation von Upselling-, Cross-Selling- und Erweiterungspotenzialen
* Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
* Proaktive Betreuung bestehender Kunden sowie Durchführung regelmässiger Business Reviews
* Verantwortung für eine strukturierte und gut gepflegte Sales-Pipeline
* Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der CRM-Datenqualität
* Entwicklung skalierbarer Abläufe für ein professionelles und wachstumsorientiertes Sales Management
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung, Customer Success und weiteren internen Teams
* Einbringen von Kundenfeedback aus Sales, Onboarding und Betreuung in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Software
* Aktive Mitgestaltung unserer Vertriebsstrategie und unseres weiteren Marktausbaus
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Kaufmännische oder technische Grundausbildung
* Erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Account Management oder Business Development
* Idealerweise Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-, Software- oder Technologieumfeld
* Branchenkenntnisse in der Bau-, Architektur-, Ingenieur- oder Immobilienbranche
* Ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu Architekten, Ingenieuren, Planern, GUs, Bauunternehmen oder Kantonen ist ein grosser Vorteil
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
* Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Sachverhalte schnell zu verstehen und einfach und verständlich zu erklären
* Sicheres und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und Entscheidungsträgern
* Verhandlungsgeschick und Abschlussstärke
* Unternehmerisches Denken und die Fähigkeit, Potenziale frühzeitig zu erkennen
* Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Hohe Eigeninitiative und Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
* Führerausweis Kategorie B und Bereitschaft zu Kundenterminen innerhalb der Schweiz
## What's on Offer ##
* Viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Home-Office-Möglichkeiten
* Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine unkomplizierte Unternehmenskultur
* Modernes SaaS-Umfeld mit direktem Einfluss auf die Digitalisierung der Baubranche
* Fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
* Modernes Firmenfahrzeug für deine Kundentermine
* Attraktive und leistungsorientierte Entlöhnung
* Ein dynamisches Team, in dem Eigeninitiative und unternehmerisches Denken geschätzt werden

Bern, Lausanne

Weitersagen

Du baust gerne neue Märkte auf und überzeugst Menschen von digitalen Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert?

Dann könnte diese Rolle genau zu dir passen. Für unser SaaS-Produkt STRATUS suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit, die den Markt in der Romandie aktiv weiterentwickelt, Neukund:innen gewinnt und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut. Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss und darüber hinaus.

Das bewegst du

Als Business Development & Sales Manager:in entwickelst du den Markt für unser SaaS-Produkt STRATUS – unsere digitale Lösung für das Immobilienmanagement – in der Romandie aktiv weiter. Du identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, gewinnst Neukund:innen und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Dabei gestaltest du die Marktbearbeitung eigenverantwortlich und trägst wesentlich zum Wachstum unseres SaaS-Geschäfts bei.

Du führst den gesamten Sales Cycle eigenverantwortlich – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsanalyse und die Präsentation unserer Softwarelösungen bis zur Erstellung von Angeboten, Vertragsverhandlungen und dem erfolgreichen Abschluss. Potenzielle Kund:innen überzeugst du telefonisch, digital, an Fachveranstaltungen sowie persönlich vor Ort. Dabei verstehst du ihre Herausforderungen und zeigst auf, wie unsere Lösungen einen echten Mehrwert für ihr Immobilienmanagement schaffen.

Auch nach dem Vertragsabschluss bleibst du eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen. Du begleitest die Einführung unserer Lösung, führst Anwenderschulungen durch und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Nutzung von STRATUS. Gleichzeitig bringst du die Erkenntnisse aus dem Markt und aus Kundengesprächen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Lösungen und unserer Marktbearbeitung ein.

Das bringst du mit

Du verfügst über mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb – idealerweise im Verkauf von Softwarelösungen oder anderen erklärungsbedürftigen Dienstleistungen – und hast Freude daran, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, Hartnäckigkeit und Abschlussstärke zeichnen dich aus. Du erkennst Chancen im Markt, gehst aktiv auf Menschen zu und verstehst es, Vertrauen nachhaltig aufzubauen.

Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Französisch und bewegst dich sicher im Geschäftsumfeld der Romandie. Die Businesskultur der Westschweiz ist dir vertraut, und du verstehst es, Beziehungen auf Augenhöhe aufzubauen. Deutschkenntnisse sind willkommen und erleichtern die Zusammenarbeit mit der Deutschschweiz.

Du arbeitest strukturiert, nutzt digitale Tools selbstverständlich und gehst Herausforderungen mit Eigeninitiative und einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität an. Eine Aus- oder Weiterbildung im Verkauf, in der Immobilienbranche oder im betriebswirtschaftlichen Umfeld ist von Vorteil. Idealerweise wohnst du im Drei-Seen-Land oder in den Kantonen Jura oder Waadt.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Wir sind ein unabhängiges Ingenieur-, Planungs- und Beratungsunternehmen und gestalten mit innovativen Lösungen die Zukunft in den Bereichen Bau, Mobilität, Energie und strategisches Portfoliomanagement. Im Fachbereich STRATUS erwartet dich Start-up-Spirit in einem etablierten Expertenumfeld – kollegial, wertschätzend und unkompliziert. Du übernimmst viel Eigenverantwortung und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres SaaS-Geschäfts in der Romandie aktiv mit.

Wir bieten dir ein Pensum von 50 bis 100 Prozent im Jahresarbeitszeitmodell sowie Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten nach der Einarbeitung. Das flexible Pensum eröffnet bewusst auch erfahrenen Persönlichkeiten sowie Wiedereinsteiger:innen – beispielsweise nach einer Familienzeit – attraktive Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten und mobilem Arbeiten lassen sich unterschiedliche Lebensmodelle gut mit dem Berufsalltag vereinbaren.

Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einer attraktiven Pensionskassenlösung, ÖV-Vergünstigungen wie GA oder Halbtax, einer Mensa beziehungsweise Cafeteria sowie regelmässigen Teamevents. Gezielte interne und externe Weiterbildungen unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Das zeichnet uns aus

Bei uns begegnen sich junge und erfahrene Fachpersonen auf Augenhöhe. Wir pflegen eine Kultur des gegenseitigen Respekts und eine unkomplizierte, prestigefreie Atmosphäre.

Als Team entwickeln wir unser SaaS-Produkt und unsere Marktbearbeitung kontinuierlich weiter. Wir teilen unser Wissen proaktiv, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und arbeiten eng zusammen, um für unsere Kund:innen praxisnahe digitale Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert zu entwickeln. Eigeninitiative, kurze Entscheidungswege und der Wille, gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein, prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations.

Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide.

Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere
We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Remote - US or Canada
From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere!
We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

Sardine is building a dedicated go-to-market motion for the crypto vertical. This AE role is the first US seat in that motion, reporting solid-line into our Sales team and dotted-line into the GM, Crypto & Payments.
Your account set is crypto-native: exchanges, wallets, custodians, on/off-ramps, stablecoin issuers, and L1/L2 ecosystems. You will own new business across this segment and carry the primary field presence at conferences where these buyers actually make vendor decisions.
This is a platform displacement role. The dominant competitors in this segment are entrenched point solutions. The deals you close will consolidate fragmented vendor stacks onto Sardine's integrated risk and compliance platform spanning fraud, KYC/KYB, AML/transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, device intelligence, and case management.

Regulatory deadlines (MiCA, the GENIUS Act, and similar) are active deal catalysts you will be expected to use. The GM owns vertical strategy, deal structure, and executive relationships. You own pipeline generation, qualification, and close.

Build and maintain a qualified pipeline across crypto-native account segments. Conference presence is the primary channel. You will be on the floor at Consensus, Token2049, Permissionless, and comparable events, developing relationships that convert to pipeline.
Run multi-threaded discovery sessions with compliance, risk, legal, and technical buyers simultaneously. Crypto deals rarely close through a single stakeholder.
Position Sardine as a full-stack compliance and onboarding orchestration platform. You need to credibly speak to AML/TM, KYC/KYB, sanctions, and device intelligence as integrated surfaces, not add-ons.
Structure and negotiate complex, multi-module platform deals. Work with Solutions Engineering on technical scoping, and with the GM on commercial structure, pricing, and contract terms.
Use regulatory forcing functions including MiCA, the GENIUS Act, and BCB Resolution 520 as deal urgency where they apply. You need to understand why they matter, not just reference them.
Feed vertical market intelligence back to the GM and product teams: competitor moves, product gap patterns, deal structure objections.
Collaborate cross-functionally within Sardine to close deals and provide market feedback from the crypto segment.

5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience with at least 2 to 3 years selling into crypto-native companies. Time in fintech without crypto-specific buyer exposure does not substitute.
A network at the compliance, risk, and product leadership level inside crypto exchanges, custodians, wallets, or stablecoin platforms. This network is a first-round filter, not a nice-to-have.
Working fluency in AML/TM, KYC/KYB, and sanctions as they apply to crypto. You need to hold a credible conversation with a Chief Compliance Officer or VP of Risk without SE support for the basics.
Demonstrated ability to run multi-threaded, multi-month sales cycles with multiple internal stakeholders on both sides of the deal.
Experience structuring and closing platform deals: multi-module, multi-year. Not transactional SaaS subscriptions.
Willingness to travel to crypto industry conferences and client sites. Travel demand for this role is higher than a standard enterprise AE position.
Ability to work with a GM who owns deal strategy and an SE team who supports technical scoping. Clear ownership boundary: you own pipeline and close.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and writing skills.
Proven ability to work across a matrixed, globally distributed organization.

Jumia is a leading pan-African e-commerce platform. Its mission is to improve the quality of everyday life in Africa by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, convenient and affordable online services to customers, while helping businesses grow as they use Jumia's platform to better reach and serve customers.
Jumia is built around a marketplace and supported by a proprietary logistics business [Jumia Logistics] and a digital payment and fintech platform [Jumia Pay] . With over 3,000 employees, Jumia is led by top talented leaders offering a great mix of local and international talents and is backed by very high-profile shareholders. Jumia is committed to creating a sustainable impact in Africa.
In April 2019, Jumia was the first Tech company in Africa to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Key Account Manager (KAM) for Appliance & TV is a strategic commercial role dedicated to driving the growth, revenue, and market share of Jumia’s home appliances and television portfolio (including major domestic appliances, small kitchen electronics, and smart TVs).

Acting as the primary commercial link, this role is responsible for managing high-value relationships with top global consumer electronics brands, regional distributors, and local appliance vendors.

By analyzing consumer electronics market trends and securing competitive pricing, exclusive range launches, and stock availability, the KAM ensures that Jumia remains the preferred destination for home appliance and TV shoppers.
What you will be doing
Vendor & Account Management: Manage key accounts, top brands, and distributors within the Appliance & TV category to build strong, long-lasting commercial partnerships.
Commercial Growth: Develop and implement category-specific commercial strategies to scale sales volume, maximize revenue, and grow Jumia's appliance and TV market share.
Campaign Execution: Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to create and execute high-impact promotional campaigns (e.g., Tech Week, Black Friday, Home Makeover sales) tailored to home electronics consumers.
Market Analysis: Analyze sales data, stock turn, and consumer electronics market trends to identify growth opportunities, gap assortments, and competitive pricing strategies.
Performance Tracking: Monitor and report on core category metrics, including GMV, stock health/inventory levels, and vendor operational fulfillment.
Commercial Negotiations: Lead commercial negotiations to secure exclusive product launches, best-in-market pricing, and optimal margin contributions from appliance and TV vendors.
Vendor Support: Provide proactive business support to key partners, resolving operational bottlenecks and tracking their growth on the platform.
Industry Expertise: Stay deeply updated on global and local consumer electronics trends, display technologies (e.g., OLED, QLED, Smart OS), energy-efficiency standards, competitor positioning, and shifting consumer home preferences.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with operations, logistics, and content teams to ensure seamless inbound scheduling for heavy and bulky goods, stock availability, and high-quality product listings.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
Professional Experience: Minimum 2 years of proven commercial or account management experience, ideally within the e-commerce, consumer electronics, or home appliance retail industries.
Category Expertise: A strong understanding of the Appliance & TV category, including deep knowledge of home electronics specifications, major vs. small domestic appliances, display tech, and brand positioning.
Commercial & Negotiation Skills: Sharp commercial acumen with excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills to secure premium deals with major appliance and TV brands.
Analytical Capabilities: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and data tools to monitor inventory health, sales targets, and market trends.
Strategic & Results-Driven: Ability to think strategically and execute actionable commercial plans that consistently drive category GMV and growth.
Agility & Drive: A proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to thrive, prioritize, and multi-task within a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.
Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source.

Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.
With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.
With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S. , connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.
We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

Compensation: Strong base salary + uncapped commission structure with clear accelerators for over-performance.
We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented Account Executive (Full Cycle) to take strong ownership of our revenue growth through consistent, targeted outbound prospecting and strategic closing. This is a high-impact, mid-to-senior level role designed for a true "hunter" who thrives on turning cold opportunities into high-quality, long-term B2B clients for our SSC and Pro product lines.
This role runs in two gears : sharp and disciplined in creating pipeline — targeted, creative outbound to a defined ICP, disciplined qualification, and efficiently filtering out deals that aren't a fit — and consultative once you're in the room, where discovery and product education come before the pitch and multi-stakeholder deals are won on understanding, not pressure.
In this role, you won't just wait for inbound leads—you will own the entire sales lifecycle . From dedicated outbound prospecting and strategic qualification to leading compelling product demos and closing complex deals, you will drive the pipeline that fuels our expansion. If you are motivated by building a robust book of business from scratch and find purpose in driving net-new revenue, you’ll thrive in this position.
What You'll Be Selling
Sponsored Scholarship Campaigns (SSC) — Our flagship product, and a performance marketing channel rather than a philanthropy program. It's built on the foundation of something Gen Z is already looking for: scholarships, not ads. The brand earns the next generation of customers, and students earn financial aid.

We build the campaign with the client and run the scholarship end to end, so the brand reaches a US Gen Z audience through a channel that's permission-based by design rather than interruptive, and generates first-party, opt-in insights at scale .
What that solves varies by client, and learning to read which version you're selling is a real part of the job: customer and user acquisition, lead generation, recruiting pipeline, content, or serious brand engagement with the next generation of buyers. Your buyer is typically a Growth Manager or marketing lead at a brand or agency that sells to Gen Z, and you're competing for performance marketing budget against paid social and search, not against other scholarship platforms.
ScholarshipOwl Pro — Scholarship management for organizations already running their own scholarship programs in cumbersome or inefficient ways: shorter cycle, more operational, philanthropic buyer , and a second motion alongside SSC.

Time to value — getting customers to meaningful adoption and depth of use inside what they already own. You drive this; you don't wait for it.
Secure renewal — retention, multi-year capture, and forecast accuracy across your book.
Upsell and cross-sell — expansion within your existing customers: more users, adjacent products, new use cases inside the relationships you already hold.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers (Sudoeste), Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.
We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.
You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal.

As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.
Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.
Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.
Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.
Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.
Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

s.h: Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.
s.t:
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
Halter in Argentina
Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

s.h: Why our team loves working at Halter
s.t:
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers (Oeste Arenoso), Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.
We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.
You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal.

As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.
Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.
Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.
Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.
Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.
Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

s.h: Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.
s.t:
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
Halter in Argentina
Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

We’re looking for a driven, high-performing Account Manager to join the momentum and help shape the future of farming in the South Auckland region. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer groundbreaking change, working with some of the highest-performing dairy farms in New Zealand.

Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability.

You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the North Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have.
Location - This role is to be based anywhere in the South Auckland / North Waikato region. Frequent travel is required as part of the position.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Revenue Retention & Expansion: You will own the retention, renewals and expansion targets of Halter’s existing revenue in the region.
Ensure farmers are extracting full value from Halter to achieve their goals and ultimately understand the impact it’s having on their farming business.
Account Management: Responsible for renewing customer agreements and expanding the revenue of existing Halter customers, by adding value in every interaction to drive on-farm goals and performance.
Deployment: Supporting the onboarding, training and implementation of the Halter system on customers' farms, ensuring all relevant farm owners, managers, and workers are able to successfully use the system.
Relationship Building: Proactively cultivate genuine and trustworthy relationships with farmers, their teams, and families, fostering strong connections and understanding.
Farmer Success: Strategically partnering with customers to establish clear business goals, timelines, priorities and metrics of success.
Problem-Solving: Provide prompt and effective communication and support to farmers and team members, addressing technical or operational challenges with expertise and efficiency.
Community & Networking: Represent the Halter brand with pride, lead local discussion groups, and proactively build strong networks within the community for increased brand visibility and connections.
Customer Advocate: Acting as the voice of the customer and bridging the gap with our product teams to provide important context about what is happening on the ground with our farmers and their animals.
Technical Expertise : Working closely with our product teams to provide technical and practical advice from a farmer’s perspective on everything reproduction, pasture and agronomy.
Contribute to a positive team environment, supporting others to succeed and role modelling Halter’s Operating Principles.
Who we’re looking for: We’re backing potential over polish. These are the traits that matter most:
A great human first
You bring integrity, humility, and care. You do what you say you’ll do. You show up for your farmers and your teammates.
Lifelong learner mindset
You’re genuinely curious. You ask questions, seek feedback, and are excited to keep levelling up alongside a world‑class team.
Hunger and grit
You love chasing ambitious goals, solving hard problems, and sticking with it when things get tough.
Positive energy and team spirit
You lift the people around you, not drain them. You enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and celebrating others’ wins as much as your own.
Comfort in a fast‑moving environment
You’re at your best when things are dynamic. You can work autonomously, manage your time well, and stay focused on what matters most.
The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.
A hunger for success and personal growth, and an eagerness to evolve alongside a world-class team.
And these pieces give you an advantage, but are not a prerequisite:
3-5 years of experience in relationship management/account management roles.
Experience in dairy farming or within the agriculture sector with a deep passion for helping farmers succeed.
Strong business and commercial acumen

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

This is your chance to build Mollie's presence in Denmark from the ground up, as the first person hired with this market as your sole focus. You won't be starting from zero: you'll have the Nordic foundation already built in Sweden to work from, but the Danish playbook is yours to write.
You'll open the market, land our first Danish customers, and turn early learnings into a repeatable approach we can scale. It's a broader, more entrepreneurial scope than a standard sales role. You'll work deals from $100K a month while building toward bigger opportunities of up to $1 million a month, all while shaping how Mollie understands and enters this market for the long run.
What makes this role stand out is the mix: outbound selling, customer discovery, partnerships, and competitive analysis, all rolled into one seat with real ownership. If you want to build something rather than maintain something, this is that opportunity.
What you'll ship
Run outbound sales and manage the full sales process, including around 20 cold calls a week
Build a Danish pipeline and land Mollie's first customers in the market
Gather market feedback and grow larger opportunities, including deals of up to $1 million a month
Build relationships with Danish agencies and work on partnerships alongside the partner manager based in Stockholm
Share what you learn about the Danish marketing landscape with the marketing team to help shape events and go-to-market plans
Run competitive analysis to sharpen how Mollie positions itself in Denmark

Around 5 years of full-cycle sales experience, with a strong outbound track record and demonstrated success in structured cold outreach
Value selling capability, with a data-driven approach to activity and pipeline management
Strong negotiation and contract handling skills, including experience communicating and negotiating with C-level stakeholders
Creativity in building a pipeline through partnerships or marketing outreach (you don't need to have done this before, just show the potential)
Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS sales, built across multiple companies
Comfortable working hands-on in a role with broad scope and real uncertainty
Fluency in Danish

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

The Partnerships team supports OpenAI’s mission by building and managing external relationships that expand product reach, accelerate adoption, strengthen strategic capabilities, and help the company scale responsibly. We partner across the organization to develop a go to market ecosystem strategy, create shared value, and support relationships that are critical to OpenAI’s growth.

We’re looking for a Partnerships Sales Manager to lead high-impact co-sell relationships across our go to market sales teams and our system integrators and solution partners. You’ll manage a portfolio of strategic external partners—including technology platforms, distribution channels, service providers, and other ecosystem partners—and work closely with internal sales teams to turn business needs into effective partnership strategies in order to deliver customer value and outcomes.
This role combines relationship management, commercial judgment, and hands-on execution. You’ll help evaluate new partners, negotiate agreements, improve existing programs, and create the operating mechanisms needed to manage partnerships at scale.
This role is based in New York in office 3 days a week.
In this role, you will
Own and deepen relationships with key strategic and ecosystem partners.
Drive a partner first strategy across your assigned field territory alongside GTM teams
Develop partnership strategies aligned with OpenAI’s product, go-to-market, and operational priorities.
Source, evaluate, and onboard new partners and service providers.
Lead commercial negotiations in partnership with Legal, Business Operations, Procurement, Security, and other stakeholders.
Translate complex business requirements into clear partner selection criteria and operating plans.
Establish performance metrics, governance processes, and regular business reviews for strategic relationships.
Identify opportunities to improve economics, service quality, resilience, and scalability across the partner portfolio.
Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving Sales, Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Marketing, Business Operations, and other partner-facing teams.
Monitor market developments, ecosystem shifts, and emerging capabilities across relevant partner categories.
Prepare recommendations and decision materials for senior leaders.
Anticipate partnership risks and lead their resolution with internal and external stakeholders.
You might thrive in this role if you
Have 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, ecosystem development, platform partnerships, go-to-market alliances, or a related field.
Have direct sales and/or sales overlay experience.
Have managed complex relationships with technology platforms, distribution partners, service providers, infrastructure companies, or other critical strategic partners.
Are an effective negotiator with strong commercial instincts and experience structuring sophisticated agreements.
Can analyze commercial and operational data and turn it into clear recommendations.
Work well across technical, commercial, legal, go-to-market, and operational teams.
Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, setting priorities, and building new processes in a fast-moving environment.
Communicate clearly with executives, partners, and subject-matter experts.
Pair strategic thinking with a willingness to own detailed execution.
Exercise excellent judgment when working with confidential or sensitive information.

Experience supporting a rapidly scaling global technology company.
Familiarity with technology ecosystems, platform and infrastructure business models, distribution channels, go-to-market partnerships, or partner risk management.
Experience developing partner scorecards, governance frameworks, and executive business reviews.
Background working in a regulated or operationally complex environment.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta is growing fast—we’re profitable, consistently exceeding our growth targets, and maintaining exceptionally strong NPS scores along the way. Our momentum is driven by a clear mission: to secure the internet and help startups scale with trust. As the category leader in compliance and security automation, we’re capturing market share rapidly, and our Sales team is at the forefront of that charge.
To support this continued growth, we’re expanding our Early Stage Sales team. We’re looking for high-energy, customer-focused French speaking Account Executive who thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments and are motivated by the challenge of turning velocity into results.

In this role, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle—from first touch to close—and play a critical role in positioning Vanta as the go-to solution for early-stage companies navigating security and compliance for the first time.
This is a highly transactional, new business role where success comes from running a tight, repeatable process and maintaining a high daily output.
If you love the energy of working with startups, are driven to outperform targets, and want to make a tangible impact in a rapidly scaling business, we’d love to hear from you.
This role will be based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
What you’ll do as an Account Executive, Early Stage - EMEA at Vanta:
Identify high-potential business verticals to develop and execute outbound strategies to engage them with Vanta.
Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, with a focus on speed and efficiency, aiming to close deals within a 30-day timeframe.
Turn our inbound demand into closed-won business quickly and consistently, working across a large number of prospects
Operate in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment, running a high number of discovery calls and managing a broad pipeline of opportunities simultaneously.
Continuously optimize your sales workflow to maintain high activity levels, improve conversion, and deliver repeatable results.
Define and communicate the value of Vanta to prospects, including tailoring sales materials and demos to resonate with early-stage startup buyers
Surface product feedback and trends from prospects to inform go-to-market and product development strategies.

Thrive in high-velocity sales environments and are energized by repetition, fast decision-making, and a transactional approach to deal flow
Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.
Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects.
Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up.
You’re intrinsically motivated, proactive, and resourceful—comfortable taking initiative without needing direction
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation.

Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

À propos du poste
En tant que responsable de compte Entreprise chez Anthropic, vous intégrerez l’équipe fondatrice en charge du déploiement de nos solutions API et SaaS de productivité, à la pointe de l’IA, à destination des organisations du secteur automobile en France.

Vous favoriserez l’adoption d’une IA sûre et de pointe en concluant des accords stratégiques avec des constructeurs automobiles, des équipementiers de rang 1 et de rang 2, ainsi que des fournisseurs de solutions de mobilité.

Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise en vente consultative dans le secteur automobile pour stimuler la croissance du chiffre d’affaires, tout en devenant un partenaire de confiance pour les parties prenantes du secteur automobile.

Vous les accompagnerez dans l’intégration et le déploiement de l’IA, en explorant tout son potentiel dans les domaines de l’ingénierie et de la conception, des opérations de fabrication, des services de véhicules connectés et de l’après-vente.

En collaboration avec les équipes GTM, Produit et Marketing, vous affinerez continuellement notre proposition de valeur, notre méthodologie de vente et notre positionnement sur le marché afin de répondre aux besoins des décideurs du secteur automobile.
Le candidat idéal est passionné par le développement de nouveaux segments de marché, par l'identification des opportunités à fort potentiel et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour les saisir. En favorisant le déploiement des produits émergents d'Anthropic, vous aiderez les entreprises à acquérir de nouvelles capacités tout en favorisant le développement éthique de l'IA.

Développez le portefeuille clients et stimulez les revenus d’Anthropic dans le secteur automobile. Naviguez au sein d’organisations complexes du secteur automobile pour identifier les décideurs clés, les informer sur nos services et les accompagner vers le succès avec Anthropic. Vous serez responsable de l’ensemble du cycle de vente, depuis le premier contact jusqu’à la conclusion.

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Location: Paris
About the Department
Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences.
The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.

Our Southern Europe Sales Team has been building an Enterprise focussed team spanning across mid-tier and all the way up to Global 2000 Enterprise accounts. Cloudflare has accelerated bringing both Enterprise and Fortune 1000 companies onto our platform in recent years, and this team will do that with more focus, faster pace, and higher long term growth expectations.
As the Sales Manager you will lead our France Mid Market Sales Team. The position will require leadership that spans go-to-market strategy development, managing Mid Market Account Executives and key account planning program development and implementation, executive relationship mapping and alignment, cultivating deep levels of trust and product co-creation, balancing short term with long term sales cycles and collaborating extensively cross-functionally to bring to bear product, marketing, support, success, solution engineering and channel onto our highest growth potential accounts.

Team Building & Hiring: Continue to build, recruit, and coach the France Mid-Market Sales Team in close partnership with recruiting resources and regional leadership.
Team Leadership: Direct leadership of Mid-Market Account Executives (AEs), while aligning cross-functional support roles (BDRs, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Field Marketing).
Execution & Revenue Growth: Drive sales growth through operational rigor, consistent pipeline generation, tight sales execution, and targeted regional go-to-market initiatives.
Process & Methodology: Implement and drive best practices using the company’s sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) across pipeline management, forecasting, and account expansion.
Regional Strategy: Execute sales strategies tailored to the French mid-market segment and mid-sized enterprises (ETI), ensuring fast sales cycles and quick customer time-to-value.
Deal Support: Act as an operational point of contact and dynamic "player-coach" to help close strategic mid-market deals and resolve operational roadblocks.
Governance: Ensure corporate policy and sales standards are consistently followed by the team.
Cadence & Rigor: Maintain a structured operational cadence: weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, 1-on-1 coaching sessions, deal reviews, and team meetings.

Experience: 5+ years of sales management experience in B2B SaaS/Tech, preceded by a strong track record as an individual contributor selling into mid-sized businesses.
Language skills : Fluency in French and English is required.
Mid-Market Focus: Proven success managing medium-length, high-velocity sales cycles (30–90 days) with a strong quarterly execution cadence.
Ecosystem Knowledge: Solid understanding of the French IT, Cloud, and Cybersecurity landscape (mid-market / ETI segment).
Technical Aptitude: Experience or strong familiarity with cloud security, network performance, Zero Trust, SASE, and modern web architecture.
Sales Rigor: Mastery of sales methodologies, CRM hygiene (Salesforce), pipeline generation strategies, and accurate quarterly forecasting.
Leadership Style: Hands-on leader capable of coaching, developing early-to-mid career AEs, and driving high team energy and performance.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
