Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Renewals are the heartbeat of Samsara’s long-term success. As a Renewals Account Executive for our Canadian Mid-Market segment, you will lead the commercial strategy for a portfolio of 50–75 high-value accounts per quarter. This is a high-impact role where you will be responsible for securing favourable renewal terms while minimizing financial attrition, identifying growth opportunities, passing findings and insights back to the business, and closing 36-month renewal deals.
Your mission is to balance efficiency with high-touch strategic negotiation, ensuring our Canadian customers continue to see Samsara as their "source of truth" and long term partner for physical operations.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work, whether you’re diving into the inner workings of a food distribution center or a waste management firm to understand how our technology makes them better.
You thrive in a competitive arena and play to win: You aren't intimidated by a "save" cycle; you lean into it. You are a creative thinker who can confidently advocate for a customer’s resources at time of renewal and prove why Samsara remains their best-in-class partner. You expect to win because you believe in our value, and you have the grit to defend our footprint against any competitor.
You are a Master of Prioritization : You know how to triage a book of business, while dedicating deep strategic work to your six-figure "anchor" accounts. You take pride in a clean forecast, and know that deal execution is an essential part of hitting your numbers.
You are a Value Architect who builds genuine relationships: You don’t just "process" a contract; you re-confirm the business case. You build trust quickly, and you can articulate ROI to a CFO or operational value to a Fleet Manager with equal fluency.
You can navigate internal complexity to win as a team : You recognize that sales is a team sport. You are comfortable collaborating with Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance to navigate custom terms and "get to yes" on agreements, all while sharing best practices to help the broader team succeed.
You want to be with the best: You thrive in a high-performance culture where you are surrounded by top-tier talent. You are looking for a role that challenges you to go farther than you have before, moving with urgency and a growth mindset to secure the revenue that fuels Samsara’s mission.

Own the Canadian Mid-Market: Act as the primary commercial lead for a portfolio of 50–75 renewals per quarter. You will manage high-touch accounts ranging from $25k to $300k+ , serving as a dedicated expert on the Canadian business landscape, local competitors, and regional market trends.
Drive Full-Cycle Commercial Execution: Lead every stage of the renewal process, from initial quoting and complex negotiations to securing internal approvals. You will prioritize 36-month terms to stabilize the partnership and maximize long-term Lifetime Value (LTV).
Forecast with Precision: Maintain impeccable Salesforce hygiene to ensure your pipeline is a "single source of truth." You will provide leadership with scenario forecasting, clear visibility into territory risks, and data-driven insights that make your outcomes predictable.
Strategize Across the Account Team: Partner seamlessly with CSMs and AEs to map out expansion opportunities. You will bridge the gap between retention and growth, identifying expansion opportunities while ensuring a frictionless, unified experience for the customer.
Operate as a Business Owner: Take full accountability for your territory’s health. You don't just manage a list; you proactively solve for churn, advocate for the needs of the Canadian market, and lean into the "owner" mindset to hit and exceed your retention targets.

Experience: 2+ years of full-cycle closing or strategic renewals experience, specifically managing Mid-Market or Commercial accounts.
Commercial acumen: Proven track record of managing $1M+ in quarterly quota with deal sizes above $100k
Canadian Market Context: Experience navigating the Canadian business landscape (familiarity with regional industries like transport, construction, or field services is a plus).
Negotiation Prowess: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder "save" cycles and handle complex procurement/legal requirements.
Operational Excellence: Expert proficiency in Salesforce and a disciplined approach to pipeline management.

Own your own leverage. Continuously identify the repetitive parts of the role — research, prep, notes, follow-up, list building and systematically get them off your plate, so the majority of your week is spent in live conversation with operators.

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving
upmarket.This role is the person who helps build the commercial motion as we shift towards increasingly complex upmarket accounts.

As Manager of Mid-Market Sales for Toast Retail, you will lead a small team of Mid-Market Account Executives pursuing multi-location retail with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not exist at Toast Retail yet. You will build it.
This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a playbook and run it well. There is no Mid-Market Toast Retail playbook. A growing set of proof points from our SMB business, a leadership team that is investing, and a set of open questions that someone has to go answer.

What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which of our SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain?

You will form the hypotheses, run them in the field, and turn what works into something repeatable that the next ten AEs can execute.
Expect to spend real time outside your own team.

Getting this motion off the ground means sitting with Product on inventory and scan data gaps, with Marketing on messaging that lands with a category buyer, with Enablement on training that does not exist yet, with Deal Desk and Finance on structures we have not offered before, and with Onboarding on implementations that are meaningfully harder than a single site install.

Your ability to move those partners without formal authority over any of them will matter as much as your ability to coach a deal.
This is a player coach role in year one. You will carry a number yourself while you hire and build the team, which means you will be closing Mid-Market Retail deals before you are coaching them. That is deliberate. The person who writes this playbook should draw from their own first-hand experiences from running the motion, not just observations of other people running it. As the team scales, your quota shifts to theirs.
You will report to the VP of Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations up to 40 percent of the time.
A day in the life
Carry and deliver an individual quota in year one (player-coach) while you hire, onboard, and ramp your team, transitioning to a full team number as your team scales.
Hire, develop, motivate, and manage a quota achieving Mid-Market sales team from the ground up, setting the bar for talent in a brand new function
Build and codify the Mid-Market Retail sales process: discovery frameworks, demo flows, business case models, mutual action plans, and executive proposals tailored to grocery, liquor, and convenience buyers
Run a disciplined sales process and coach your team on qualification rigor, multithreading, and champion development inside complex retail organizations
Own live Mid-Market deals end to end yourself, then convert what you learn into discovery frameworks, demo flows, business cases, and proposals the team can run
Get in the field. Join discovery calls, sit in on site visits, and walk stores with your reps so the playbook you write is grounded in what actually happens in front of a customer
Own all stages of the sales lifecycle with your team: pipeline generation, executive meetings, value proposition development, deal structuring, negotiation, and close
Partner across Product, Marketing, Enablement, Deal Desk, Finance, and Onboarding to close the gaps that stand between us and a repeatable Mid-Market motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself
Bring the voice of the Mid-Market retailer back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes
Forecast accurately in a business with little historical data, and be honest about what you know versus what you are still learning
Assess and engage in competitive RFPs
Leverage GTM tech stack to run an efficient, AI-anchored motion: establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet, and report on them credibly.
Distinguish repeatable process from one off hero deals, and build only the former into the playbook
Stay close to the competitive landscape across grocery, liquor, and convenience technology, and position Toast Retail sharply against incumbents

About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.
That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move . When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

s.h: THIS IS A REAL STEP INTO CLOSING
s.t:
You booked the meeting. Someone else closed it. Not here.
Your number. Your accounts. Your calls. Your deals. Start to finish.
You already know this feeling
You worked the account for weeks. You found the pain, you got the right person on the phone, you booked the meeting. Then you handed it over and watched someone else take it to signature and pick up the commission.
This is the seat where you keep it.

You own a UK and Ireland mid-market patch and carry a monthly new-business ARR target. You find every opportunity yourself, and you close it yourself. There is no SDR underneath you and nobody filling your diary. We give you the data, the tools, the coaching and a few live opportunities to get you moving. Everything after that is yours to build.
If that reads as a warning, this is not your role. If it reads as an opportunity, keep going.
What you’ll actually be doing
Picking your target accounts and going after them properly
Cold calling. Every week. It does not stop being part of the job when you start closing
Running discovery that reaches business impact, not a feature checklist
Demoing Joblogic to operations directors, finance and business owners
Multi-threading, building the commercial case, negotiating and closing
Keeping HubSpot honest and forecasting a number you are happy to be held to
What we’ll give you
A structured 90-day ramp into discovery, demonstrations, commercials and closing. You will never be guessing what good looks like
Full coaching as standard: MEDDPICC is our qualification standard and we will teach it to you, alongside discovery, demo and negotiation training, weekly call reviews and deal clinics
Live opportunities at the start to get you selling while you build your own engine
The data, tooling and tech stack to prospect properly, so your time goes on selling rather than list building
A real career, with a fast-growing, PE-backed software business scaling to £100M ARR. This is the first seat of a career here, not the last
You’ll love this if
You have 12-36 months as an SDR or BDR and you have smashed your number, and you can prove it with real figures

Nuestro equipo de Key Account Manager trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.
Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío
El Hunter de Expansión es un perfil netamente estratégico y de apertura de mercado. Su misión principal es desembarcar y consolidar la presencia de la compañía en nuevas zonas geográficas, nuevas plazas o verticales de negocio no exploradas (como abrir nuevas zonas en GBA o penetrar el modelo híbrido en el interior). No maneja cartera existente; su foco es el crecimiento desde cero,
Tus Responsabilidades
Apertura de Nuevas Plazas: Liderar la estrategia de entrada comercial en nuevas geografías, mapeando competidores locales y detectando barreras de entrada.
Captación Agresiva (Paid Publisher): Introducir los modelos de monetización y planes premium de la compañía en el nuevo mercado, logrando los primeros cierres clave.
Generación de Demanda Local: Desarrollar relaciones sólidas desde cero con los principales actores del mercado objetivo (inmobiliarias locales, desarrolladores)
Alianza con Operaciones: Trabajar de la mano con los equipos de producto y marketing para adaptar el discurso comercial a las particularidades culturales y económicas de la nueva plaza.
Growth Comercial: Asegurar que la nueva plaza alcance la masa crítica de listing o facturación necesaria en los plazos estipulados por el Business Plan (BP).
Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)
Experiencia: Mínimo 3 a 5 años en roles de desarrollo de negocio ( Business Development ), ventas corporativas de campo (territoriales) o expansión en empresas de tecnología/proptech.
Habilidades Blandas: Autonomía extrema, pensamiento estratégico, visión de negocio, adaptabilidad al cambio y habilidades de comunicación a nivel ejecutivo.

Votre rôle
En tant que Group Reservation & Sales Manager Multi-Site, vous êtes responsable du développement commercial et de la gestion des groupes pour nos établissements de Sion et de Fribourg.
Véritable interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des entreprises, agences, tour-opérateurs et partenaires, vous prenez en charge les dossiers de la première demande jusqu’au départ du groupe et au suivi administratif et financier qui en découle.
Votre rôle combine développement commercial, vente, négociation, gestion des réservations groupes et coordination avec les équipes opérationnelles des deux établissements.
Vos missions

· Prospecter et développer de nouveaux clients groupes : entreprises, agences, tour-opérateurs, associations, clubs, etc.

· Développer et fidéliser un portefeuille de clients existants

· Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et marchés à potentiel

· Répondre aux demandes et appels d’offres groupes

· Élaborer des offres commerciales adaptées aux besoins des clients

· Négocier les tarifs, conditions et prestations dans le respect des objectifs de l’établissement

· Effectuer les relances commerciales et assurer un suivi régulier des prospects et clients

· Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires groupes des deux établissements

s.h: GESTION DES GROUPES DE A À Z
s.t:
· Prendre en charge les demandes groupes de la première prise de contact jusqu’au départ

· Préparer les offres, contrats et conditions de réservation

· Gérer les rooming lists, échéances, acomptes et demandes particulières

· Coordonner les prestations complémentaires : restauration, salles, pauses, boissons, etc.

· Centraliser les informations et assurer leur transmission aux équipes concernées

· Anticiper les besoins spécifiques des groupes et proposer des solutions adaptées

· Assurer le suivi du dossier jusqu’à sa clôture

· Effectuer un suivi post-séjour afin de recueillir les retours clients et développer la relation commerciale

· Assurer le suivi administratif et financier des dossiers groupes

· Vérifier la conformité des prestations et tarifs facturés avec les offres et contrats

· Assurer le suivi des acomptes et échéances de paiement

· Contrôler les factures et identifier les éventuels écarts ou erreurs

· Effectuer les relances nécessaires en cas de factures ou acomptes impayés

· Collaborer avec la réception et la comptabilité pour assurer le suivi des dossiers

· Assurer le suivi des corrections, avoirs ou éventuelles réclamations liées à la facturation

· Veiller à la clôture administrative et financière des dossiers après le départ du groupe

· Gérer et répartir les demandes groupes entre les établissements de Sion et Fribourg selon les disponibilités et les besoins des clients

· Coordonner les dossiers avec les équipes réception, restauration et direction des différents sites

· Assurer une transmission claire et complète des informations aux équipes opérationnelles

· Veiller au bon déroulement des prestations vendues

· Harmoniser et améliorer les processus de gestion des groupes entre les deux établissements

· Suivre les demandes, confirmations, refus et opportunités commerciales

· Suivre le chiffre d’affaires généré par les groupes

· Analyser les performances et identifier les opportunités de développement

· Maintenir à jour les bases de données clients et le suivi de l’activité commerciale

· Participer aux actions commerciales, rendez-vous clients et événements professionnels
Votre profil

· Expérience dans la réservation groupes, le sales, le développement commercial ou l’événementiel hôtelier

· Expérience dans la gestion de groupes, un réel atout

· Excellent sens commercial et goût du challenge

· Aisance dans la négociation et la relation client

· Très bonnes capacités d’organisation, de suivi et de gestion des priorités

· Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités

· Esprit entrepreneurial, proactivité et force de proposition

· Capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément

· Excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication

· À l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes de réservation hôteliers

· Connaissance d’Opera Cloud et des outils de gestion hôtelière, un atout

· Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais

· Allemand, un réel atout

· Permis de conduire, un plus pour les déplacements entre les deux sites
Particularité du poste
Ce poste s’adresse à une personne ayant une véritable fibre commerciale et souhaitant jouer un rôle actif dans le développement des établissements.
Nous recherchons une personne capable de transformer une demande de groupe en opportunité commerciale, de négocier et vendre les prestations adaptées, puis d’assurer le suivi opérationnel, administratif et financier du dossier jusqu’à sa clôture.
La capacité à prospecter, vendre, fidéliser et développer le chiffre d’affaires est aussi importante que la rigueur nécessaire au suivi des dossiers.

Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion.

Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform.

By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers.

Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
Join Apollo as an Enterprise Account Executive (Founding Team). In this role, you’ll play a critical part in driving growth and guiding sales leaders and operations professionals through their evaluation of Apollo’s powerful, all-in-one sales platform.

As a founding member of this new segment, you’ll shape our motion, influence strategy, and set the standard for how Apollo wins in larger, more complex environments. We are AI Native
Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

At Almetra, we’re on a mission to reinvent how factories work.
We help manufacturers - one of the most essential and overlooked sectors of our economy - run better. Every car, wind turbine, medical device, and washing machine comes from a factory. But factories today are running out of people. They struggle with efficiency, safety, and quality - and they desperately need better tools to understand what’s happening on the shop floor.

Work with technical and engineering teams to understand customer requirements and develop appropriate thermal solutions.
Support customer discussions involving liquid cooling, cold plate technologies, heat exchangers, air cooling, and related thermal management architectures .
Translate customer technical requirements into actionable commercial opportunities.

Monitor developments in AI infrastructure, high-density computing, liquid cooling, and data center technologies.
Identify potential channel, technology, and ecosystem partners in the North American market.
Provide market feedback regarding customer requirements, competitive landscape, technology trends, and emerging opportunities.

Represent the company at relevant data center, AI infrastructure, thermal management, and technology industry events.
Participate in customer visits, technical seminars, conferences, and trade shows as needed.

5+ years of experience within the data center, electronics, thermal management, or related infrastructure industry .
3+ years of sales or business development experience in North America.
Direct experience selling data center thermal management, liquid cooling, cold plates, heat exchangers, cooling systems, or closely related infrastructure solutions .
Strong understanding of data center cooling technologies and the differences between liquid and air cooling architectures.
Demonstrated success developing new customers and building business opportunities from the ground up.
Experience managing complex B2B sales cycles involving technical and commercial stakeholders.
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
Ability to work independently in a remote, entrepreneurial environment.
Willingness to travel for customer meetings, industry events, and business development activities.
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal/Fluid Sciences, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Business, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

Existing relationships within the North American AI infrastructure, hyperscale data center, OEM, server, system integration, or colocation ecosystem .
Experience supporting major cloud service providers, AI computing companies, or large-scale data center customers.
Experience with high-density computing and next-generation liquid cooling applications.
Established relationships with engineering, procurement, supply chain, or infrastructure decision-makers.
Previous experience launching or expanding a product line or business territory in North America.
Experience working in a global or cross-border organization is a plus.

This position is particularly well suited for a hunter-oriented business development professional who understands both the technical and commercial sides of the data center cooling market.
The successful candidate should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, developing new relationships from scratch, navigating technical customer organizations, and turning early-stage opportunities into long-term strategic accounts.

About Semarchy Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS. Our customers use Semarchy to bring order to data spread across dozens of systems and turn it into something they can trust for reporting, operations, and AI.
The RoleWe're hiring an Account Executive for our AMER Enterprise team. You'll own a full-cycle book of business, from qualifying inbound and self-sourced pipeline through discovery, solution development, demo, negotiation, and close. Our deals are consultative and multi-stakeholder: you're rarely selling to one person, and the technical conversation is usually a proxy for a business one underneath it.
Ownership doesn't end at signature. You'll build the account plan, hand off cleanly to Professional Services and Customer Success, and come back in to lead the commercial conversation when it's time to expand, renew, or move an existing customer onto our newly upgraded platform. Responsibilities

Build pipeline. Generate and qualify opportunities through inbound requests, closed-lost revisits, referrals, and your own outbound. Keep Salesforce and Gong current as deals move, not just at quarter-end, so your forecast holds up two months out.
Run discovery that gets past the ticket. Uncover the prospect's high-level company goals, bring company and industry context into the call, and get past the technical and personal pain to the real organizational stakes: what happens if nothing changes, and why that matters to the business.
Multi-thread the deal. Identify who else needs to be in the room and bring them in deliberately, rather than waiting for the prospect to volunteer them.
Shape the solution. Understand what the prospect thinks they need, and know when to introduce a requirement they haven't asked for yet, whether that's a related module or the specific reason we're the better fit against the alternative they're evaluating.
Partner with your SC on a demo that sells the pain, not the feature. Own the value narrative and coordinate the technical demo with your Solutions Consultant, who leads it. Tie what's shown back to what the prospect named in discovery, and give your SC the lead time they need to prep, especially when a demo gets booked with less than a day's notice.
Negotiate a real plan. Know which agreement you need next given where the deal actually is, and leave every call with a specific next step, a date, and a named owner on both sides.
Build a business case your champion can carry into their own organization, tied to the financial and operational impact you uncovered together.
Manage the process to close, tracking the paper, security review, and approvals that sit between a verbal yes and a signature.
Own the account plan and the handoff. Build the plan for your named accounts, lead a clean handoff to Professional Services and Customer Success at close, and stay the commercial owner for expansion, renewal, and platform-transition conversations in your book.

A track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder software deals, ideally in data, analytics, or platform categories.
Comfort running a structured sales process while staying present and conversational. The framework should make the conversation feel more natural, not scripted.
Directness balanced with warmth. You can name a stalled buy-in or an unrealistic timeline out loud, in a way that keeps the relationship intact.
Genuine curiosity about the prospect's business, not just their tech stack. You ask a second and third “why,” and you're comfortable letting a call go somewhere your outline didn't predict.
Coachability. You take feedback, apply it, and can name your own gaps before someone else does.
A collaborative style, especially with your SC. You don't need deep technical fluency on day one; you need the instinct to loop your SC in early and work the deal together, not around them. You also bring in deal desk, partners, and leadership early.
Ownership. You flag a deal risk before it becomes a surprise, and you show up with a plan alongside it.
Judgment about where your time goes. With a growing book, you know which two or three accounts genuinely need you this week and protect the rest of your time for the next deal.

Experience selling into Snowflake or Databricks ecosystems.
Familiarity with MDM, data governance, or data quality, or the track record to get there fast.
Experience competing against vendors like Informatica or Reltio.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SpaceX is developing a new satellite-to-mobile network to bring ubiquitous cellular connectivity worldwide via the Starlink constellation. We are partnering with telecommunication companies around the world to bring this service directly from satellites to mobile phones, with the goal of providing coverage anywhere a phone can see the sky.
Starlink was designed to connect the disconnected and this new product will greatly expand that mission by extending coverage to billions of existing cellular devices. The applications range from connecting hikers in national parks, emergency responders, rural communities, remote sensors and devices, and people in emergency situations. You can learn more about the next chapter of the Starlink Mobile program here.
Combined with new state-of-the-art satellite technologies, exclusive spectrum, and Starship’s unprecedented payload capacity to low-Earth orbit in a single launch, Starlink Mobile’s next generation service will deliver unparalleled performance to cell phones and IoT devices – helping to close coverage gaps and ultimately eliminate mobile dead zones around the world.
In this role, you will take ownership of assigned client relationships and commercial opportunities to expand Starlink Mobile globally. While you will receive direct mentorship from your leaders, your work will be largely self-directed. SpaceX evolves rapidly, and you will be a critical asset to the sales team as we work to collectively advance our presence in the telecommunications market globally.

About Outreach

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions.

From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team.

World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.

Our Senior Account Executive, Enterprise team partners with prospective customers of 5,000 to 10,000 employees, owning the full deal cycle from first conversation to signed contract. We are product experts and ambassadors for Outreach, building deep knowledge of our customers' goals and pain points so they can create and close pipeline through the Outreach Sales Execution Platform.
We enjoy learning new sales trends and methodologies, going to industry events, subscribing to blogs and podcasts, reading books, and researching case studies so we can grow together. We work closely to champion our customers, share success stories, and celebrate our wins.

The primary purpose of a Senior Account Executive, Enterprise at Outreach is to lead complex, full-lifecycle sales strategy for net new, prospect accounts. This is a pure hunter role.Hunters at Outreach own the entire sales cycle, including researching, prospecting, advising, negotiating contracts, and closing deals.

You are accountable for developing account plans, using the MEDDPICC sales methodology to build new business and achieve your territory goals. You identify and deeply understand a prospect's needs, pains, and desired business outcomes, then build an effective business case that demonstrates the ROI and value of the Outreach platform.

You will partner with other members of the go-to-market team, such as Solutions Consultants, to guide prospective customers through proof of concept demos. Your primary points of contact are executive stakeholders (CRO, COO, CEO, CFO, and CISO).

Key performance indicators include quota attainment, pipeline generation and coverage, and forecast quality and accuracy.
We are an AI-forward team, using intelligent tools to research accounts, sharpen discovery, and build business cases faster than the market moves. We are looking for sellers who bring that same mindset to the C-suite, helping prospects see how Outreach's AI-powered platform turns their pipeline into predictable revenue.

Your Daily Adventures Will Include
Territory and Pipeline: Identify, research, and qualify potential new customers in your assigned territory, building pipeline coverage sufficient to achieve your sales targets.
Forecasting: Forecast deals accurately using Outreach's forecast methodology.
Account Planning: Develop and deliver on account plans that strategically increase new revenue for Outreach.
Discovery: Conduct effective discovery calls to identify and unlock the business challenges that Outreach solves.
Solution Demonstration: Demonstrate how the Outreach platform delivers a tailored solution to the outcomes a prospect is trying to achieve.
Deal Execution: Negotiate contracts with cross-functional stakeholders including C-suite, finance, procurement, and technical teams, partnering with internal go-to-market, finance, and leadership resources to drive deals to close .
Scoping and Handoff: Define accurate scoping and success criteria to position a successful implementation, and provide a smooth account transition to professional services and account management teams for future adoption and expansion.

At least 7 years of sales lifecycle management experience, preferably in a SaaS environment
Comfortable in a hunting role that is heavily focused on month over month pipeline creation
Proven experience selling AI-powered , complex solutions into medium to large organizations
Demonstrated curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, with a desire to explore how they can enhance your workflow and drive better outcomes for customers
Proven experience selling into accounts through a top-down executive motion

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.
This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner?

Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.
You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast's bottom line.
Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

Account Manager pour Academic Work Genève !
A propos du rôle
Don't leave fit to chance ! Chez Academic Work, nous sommes les experts du recrutement des professionnels en début de carrière, avec une ambition claire : devenir LE leader de la prédiction de performance.
Depuis près de 30 ans, nous déployons notre expertise dans 6 pays. Nous continuons notre croissance, et c'est pourquoi nous recherchons deux Account Managers pour renforcer notre équipe genevoise.
Notre bureau de Genève est composé de 25 collaborateurs animés par une culture de l'ambition et de plus de 150 consultants que nous sommes fiers d'accompagner chaque mois. Ce qui nous distingue ? Tâches
Le rôle d'Account Manager est un savant mélange de détermination et de réflexion stratégique. Tu portes en permanence deux casquettes : celle du Hunter, moteur de notre expansion, et celle du Conseiller, partenaire de confiance des chefs d'entreprise. Ton talent ? s.h: Concrètement, tu pilotes ton activité autour de quatre axes
s.t:
Prospection et développement de portefeuille : C'est le coeur de ta mission. Tu construis et gères ton propre portefeuille de clients de A à Z. Le cold calling est ton levier quotidien pour convaincre et obtenir des rendez\-vous stratégiques avec des responsables d'entreprise.
Analyse de besoin et négociation : Tu rencontres des directeurs et managers pour analyser leurs besoins. Tu établis les profils de candidats recherchés et mènes les négociations tarifaires. Ton but est de convaincre tes interlocuteurs de la valeur de notre accompagnement pour bâtir des collaborations à long terme.
Expertise marché et synergie interne : Fort de ta connaissance du terrain, tu apportes un regard éclairé à tes clients. Une fois le besoin identifié, tu travailles en lien étroit avec nos recruteurs.
Rigueur et résultats : Tu es responsable de tes performances. Pour assurer des résultats constants, tu appliques nos méthodes de travail avec précision, du premier contact jusqu'à la conclusion de l'accord (le closing).
Nous cherchons un tempérament, pas un CV
Peu importe tes études ou ton passé professionnel, nous cherchons les traits de caractère suivants :
Le sens de la conviction : Tu n'hésites pas à donner ton avis, même face à une figure d'autorité. Tu préfères une discussion franche au consensus facile.
Une résilience sans faille : L'échec te pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Un "non" n'est jamais une fin en soi, mais le point de départ pour trouver une autre solution.
Le goût de l'accomplissement : Tu as besoin de te fixer des défis pour avancer. Tu aimes la compétition et tu cherches un environnement où tes efforts sont récompensés à leur juste valeur.
Une curiosité naturelle : Tu aimes creuser un sujet pour en comprendre les racines. Tu poses les bonnes questions pour comprendre un problème avant d'agir.
Le sens de l'autonomie : Tu apprécies la liberté d'organiser tes journées et tu sais faire preuve d'une grande rigueur personnelle pour atteindre tes objectifs.
Prérequis
0 à 3 ans d'expérience après la fin de tes études.
Pas besoin d'expérience en Sales : nous te formons de A à Z via notre AW Sales Academy.
Français parfait et niveau avancé en anglais (C1\).
Permis de conduire (catégorie B).

Un écosystème de high\-performers : Un environnement exigeant et stimulant où l'on se tire vers le haut et où les succès sont célébrés ensemble (voyages, kick\-offs).
L'impact comme véritable moteur : Tu auras un impact direct sur le business de tes clients et sur la trajectoire des jeunes talents.
Think big \& make it happen : Un salaire fixe évolutif et un système de commissions totalement déplafonné. Ici, ton ambition est la seule limite.
L'AW Sales Academy : Un programme d'élite (2 semaines d'onboarding \+ coaching continu) pour transformer ton potentiel en expertise B2B.

11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.
Pulse & Pints Friday Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.

Native Communicator: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst Dich sicher und überzeugend im DACH-Markt bewegen.

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Call: 45 mins to meet with Sales leadership, here they will look to discuss your experience and relevance in greater detail. Understanding strengths and weaknesses.
Pleo Challenge: A 60 mins, here we look to dive deeper. This interview will be split into 2 sections 30 min mock Discovery Call, and a 15 min Pleo presentation as an Account Executive with 15 min Q&A.
Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
Last time we hired an Account Executive, we received a total of 120 applications but only 15 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light.

What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on.

A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter.

Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Once a year we also relocate to exciting places all over the world like Merida & Buenos Aires for our Toronto colleagues, cities in Europe (for our Stockholm colleagues), and cities in APAC (for our Sydney colleagues), paid for by us of course. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
Culture at Mentimeter
At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun.

We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Strategic Sales Team

Each Strategic Account Executive is responsible for maintaining high activity standards; daily prospecting, pipeline growth, prospect qualification, and delivering assigned monthly sales revenue targets.
The Strategic Sales Account Executive Opportunity
The successful Okta Account Executive is a highly motivated, self-driven, and experienced Account Executive who is passionate about security and about driving protection against the biggest identity threats.
As an Okta AE, you will be focused on providing value to C-Suite decision makers on their ability to drive the most secure environment possible for their workforce. You will consistently drive territory growth through driving both net new logos and cultivating and growing existing Okta customers. You will continually drive territory growth through both net new logos as well as through cultivating relationships to develop and grow existing Okta customers.

Holistically embrace, access, and utilize Okta partners to identify and open new, uncharted opportunities

Die SCHILLER Schweiz AG ist die Vertriebs\- und Servicegesellschaft der SCHILLER Gruppe, einem weltweit führenden Hersteller von Diagnostiktechnologie in Kardiologie, Pneumologie und Notfallmedizin: EKG\- und Ergometriesysteme, Lungenfunktionsdiagnostik, Defibrillatoren und AEDs sowie Patientenmonitoring.

Für die Betreuung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden in der Ost\-/Südostschweiz und im Tessin suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit, die Technik verständlich erklärt und Beziehungen aufbaut, die halten.
Aufgaben
Verkaufen: Du betreust Deine Bestandskunden persönlich, gewinnst neue Kunden und führst Verkaufsprozesse von der ersten Anfrage über Offerte und Ausschreibung bis zum Abschluss.
Technik erklären: Du präsentierst unsere Geräte vor Ort und an Messen, nimmst sie beim Kunden in Betrieb, schulst die Anwenderinnen und Anwender und bist erste Anlaufstelle bei Fragen – mit unserem Supportteam im Rücken.
Markt entwickeln: Du kennst Deinen Markt, erkennst Chancen wie Ersatzbeschaffungen, neue Standorte oder Ausschreibungen und planst Deine Gebietsbearbeitung selbstständig.
Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement, Service und Marketing zusammen und bringst das Feedback Deiner Kunden ins Team.
Dokumentieren: Du hältst Aktivitäten und Pipeline im CRM aktuell und leitest daraus Deine Prioritäten ab.
Qualifikation
Erfahrung im Verkauf medizintechnischer Geräte – oder ein klinischer bzw. technischerHintergrund (z. B. Pflege, Rettungssanität, Kardiotechnik, Medizintechnik HF/FH) und der klare Wille, in den Verkauf zu wechseln.
TechnischesVerständnis und Freude daran, Geräte zu erklären und Anwender sicher zu machen.
Deutsch verhandlungssicher; gute Italienischkenntnisse sind für das Tessin ein grosser Pluspunkt.
Wohnsitz im Verkaufsgebiet oder in dessen Nähe, idealerweise im Raum St. Gallen–Winterthur–Chur; Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des Gebiets und regelmässig nach Obfelden.
Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, verbindliches Auftreten und Empathie im Umgang mit Menschen im Gesundheitswesen.
Führerausweis Kat. B.

Ein etabliertes Gebiet mit bestehenden Kunden und Produkte, bei denen es um Menschen geht
Gründliche Einarbeitung und Produktschulung – auch für Quereinsteigende aus der Klinik
Viel Gestaltungsfreiraum, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kleines, familiäres Team, in dem Du wirklich etwas bewegst
Firmenfahrzeug auch zur privaten Nutzung, moderne Tools
Fixlohn plus variabler Anteil, attraktive Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
Flexible Arbeitsmodelle

This is an early-in-career opportunity intended for candidates with limited professional experience.
The CSAM is an **early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager **who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation - reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

## Executive partnership and execution ##
* Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
* Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
* Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.
## Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation ##
* Maintain deep, current account context across the pod-s defined portfolio.
* Synthesize account signals into -what-s changed / what matters now-
* Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
* Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.
## Execution orchestration (not delivery) ##
* Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
* Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
* Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
* Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.
## Reactive signal aggregation ##
* Monitor reactive support signals - case volume, aging, repeat drivers - across the pod portfolio.
* Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
* Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.
* Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.
## Operating model ##
* Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.
* Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.
* Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

## Required ##
* Bachelor-s degree (any discipline) or equivalent early-career experience.
* 0-2 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics.
* Demonstrated comfort with AI tools and AI-first ways of working.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English plus the language(s) required for the assigned hub.
* Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Zurich, Switzerland (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.) Relocation expenses are not provided as part of this role.
* Fluency in English must be mandatory
* Fluency in French AND/OR German is mandatory

* Coursework or experience in program management, business operations
* Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success.
* Experience working in pod, squad, or matrixed team structures.

Who We Are
Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.
We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools.

That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more .
Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.
Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

To continue hitting our ambitious goals, you’ll own deals from start to finish. This includes collaborating with our SDRs to qualify inbound leads and strategically prospecting into target accounts. You’ll be managing multiple deals concurrently, navigating org structures, and helping alleviate our prospects’ pain by showing the possibility, value, and impact of computer vision with Roboflow.
We're a small team, so you’ll have a key hand in shaping the sales process. That includes an eagerness to identify what’s working, creating collateral to support the process, and iterating.

You enjoy not only helping customers succeed but building processes. -Identify and qualify leads (with our SDRs) and develop them into high-value opportunities. -Build relationships with our prospects and customers, including executives in your accounts, to help understand their needs and simplify closing a deal. -Close deals efficiently: Increasing our ACV and compressing our sales cycles. -Prospect into new accounts and expand existing ones. -Keep our CRM up to date (customer info, deal size, deal status), so we can forecast and improve our sales process. -Work with technical stakeholders, including executives, to identify opportunities to accelerate the adoption of computer vision -in their business with Roboflow. -Collaborate with the rest of our team (product, marketing) to identify new features and messaging to increase the value and use of Roboflow.

Minimum 5+ years of Enterprise Account Executive experience.
Experience managing end-to-end SaaS + complex platform solution sales at a previous startup.
A track record of success in consistently building pipeline and hitting your number and overachieving.
Previous experience preferred in developer tools, cloud infrastructure, machine learning, data analytics, and/or business intelligence tooling.
A solution-based approach to selling and the ability to manage a sales process. Excellent presentation and listening skills, organization, and contact management capabilities.
A hands-on approach to learning technical concepts and leading technical discussions internally and externally with stakeholders of all levels.
Curiosity and a desire to learn as our product and sales process evolves.
What Success Looks Like
Consistently exceeds quota by landing and expanding within high-value enterprise accounts, driving meaningful revenue across multi-team deployments
Builds and owns a high-quality pipeline through strategic outbound into technical organizations (ML engineers, data scientists, platform teams) AND operations.
Quickly develops fluency in Vision AI and Roboflow’s platform—confidently leading technical and business conversations
Effectively partners with Field Engineering to run tailored demos, pilots, and evaluations that convert into production use cases
Navigates complex, technical sales cycles by aligning multiple stakeholders—from hands-on builders to executive decision-makers
Identifies high-impact use cases within customer organizations and expands footprint beyond initial entry points (new teams, new workflows, new applications)
Demonstrates strong judgment in deal strategy—knowing when to push, when to educate, and how to unblock technical or organizational friction
Maintains accurate, high-integrity pipeline and forecast (CRM hygiene), with clear visibility into deal progress, risks, and next steps
Brings back structured customer insights to influence product, messaging, and go-to-market strategy—especially around emerging AI/vision use cases

Who You'll Be Working With
Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.
As an Account Executive, you’ll partner directly with our Sales Director, CEO, and Field Engineering to scale adoption into customer accounts. You’ll also collaborate with Marketing around various campaigns and share customer feedback with Product. Finally, you'll mentor our SDRs and lead the charge as you prospect into new accounts.

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities).

We want you to work where you work best!

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.
You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.
If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Simply put, this role is a SaaS Sales "Hunter" who thrives on chasing and closing new business in the high-octane world of Media, Entertainment, Gaming, and Sports (MEGS) . You will be at the forefront of how modern audiences stream content, play games, support their favorite teams, and consume digital culture.
The ideal candidate will have at least 6 years of industry experience, 3 of which should be in a quota-carrying closing role. You know how to capture the imagination of fast-moving digital-first brands, showing them how Braze turns live game moments, launching new releases, and viral trends into real-time, highly personalized fan engagement.
Stronger fit exists with candidates who have experience working with growth-stage to mid-sized companies, and who thrive in the hands-on, high-agility culture of an enterprise sales team. Ideally, your product sales experience focuses on non-ERP solutions.

Selling analytics, CRM, marketing automation, digital media publishing, gaming tech, or content marketing solutions is the ultimate fit. Prior experience collaborating with Marketing/Sales Enablement to shape lead generation strategy is essential.

Passionate about Digital Culture: You love and understand what keeps modern consumers engaged.
SaaS Sales Specialist: Proven track record in SaaS sales; specific exposure to Mobile or Marketing Technology is strongly preferred.
Master Storyteller: Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills—able to pitch creative, high-impact engagement strategies to dynamic creative and growth leaders.
Tech-Savvy Navigator: Intermediate-to-advanced knowledge of MS Office Suite and Salesforce.com CRM. Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn new cloud applications and sales enablement platforms.
Natural Connector: A true networker in daily life through social channels and industry networks, deeply up-to-date on mobile app ecosystems and digital engagement platforms.
Deal Strategist: Proven success navigating scaling companies and complex organizations, with an instinct for identifying decision-makers and accelerating the buying process for enterprise SaaS solutions.
Startup Mindset: Prior experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology company or startup environment is a major plus.

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses.

Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement.

From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has been consistently recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was named a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2026. DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

This role is part of our Global Studios team. We create emotive yet conversion-focused ideas, products and campaigns at scale and speed. Our specialty is hyper-personalised, digital communications that change perceptions, shape new behaviours, and shift market share for our clients.

As a project manager you will be supporting across the account as a whole ensuring consistent and successful delivery of multiple projects, managing workflows and ensuring processes and running smoothly and efficiently.

You will be working closely with Designers, and the Accounts team within the agency to ensure successful campaign deliveries.

Ensure high standards are maintained and add value wherever possible
Ensure success criteria are met and projects are delivered to time and to budget
Maintain a good knowledge of all DEPT® products and services and actively promote them to clients
Escalate to senior management with internal and external issues and events that might impact accounts positively or negatively

Experience delivering a broad range of multi-channel marketing communications including digital
Extremely organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Personable, approachable demeanor and motivating team player

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter.

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What Is The Role Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within strategic Enterprise accounts.

You’ll be the owner of a defined territory where you’ll build your own pipeline, tell the Elastic Search AI story, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals in a consumption-based model.

This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration—and is critical to our growth in the Enterprise segment.
What You Will Be Doing
Own your territory & build pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social) that generates ≥50 % of your booked opportunities.
Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.
Value storytelling & demos: Craft and deliver tailored narratives and live demos that map Elastic’s Search, Observability, and Security capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up-to-date, maintaining ≥90 % forecast accuracy within ±10 %.
Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions—defend your value, structure give/get trades, and land multi-year consumption commitments.
Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.
Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 5+ years closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.
Expert discovery & qualification skills: Demonstrated ability to apply MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to drive disciplined pipeline and eliminate low-probability deals.
Compelling value storytellers: Track record of delivering executive-level presentations and demos that tie product capabilities to real dollars saved, revenue gained, or risk mitigated.
Strong negotiation chops: History of landing multi-year, high-ACV contracts while protecting margin and securing executive stakeholder buy-in.
Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including observability, security, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.
Collaborative mindset & coachability: A learner who partners effectively with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community and openness.
Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.
Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.
If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!

MongoDB is always developing and innovating — not only in our technology, but also in our sales go-to-market strategy. Our sales leadership is committed to building the best salesforce in technology. This means, inspiring and enabling success for everyone on the team.

We not only equip you to be successful and close deals, but we want your feedback and input on how we can continue to “ Think Big and Go Far .” As a crucial part of the Sales team at MongoDB, you will have access to a lucrative market and learn how to sell from some of the most successful sales leaders in the software industry.

As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive Public Sector you will play a pivotal role in driving the growth and success of MongoDB. You will be responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, cultivating relationships with key stakeholders, and ensuring the successful adoption of our solutions.

Prospect into CTOs, Engineering/IT leaders, and technical end users
Identify net-new customers through outbound prospecting
Manage the full sales cycle for all MongoDB Products & Services
Develop and execute a strategic territory plan to achieve revenue targets
Build a sales pipeline in Salesforce and Clari while maximizing prospecting tools such as Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Sendoso, and Outreach
Collaborate with the sales ecosystem to drive sales initiatives and partnerships

Fluent in English

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.
